canonical.title: Culture in Penang: A First-Timer's Guide to Museums, Festivals & Crafts

siblings.title: Eat Penang: A Street-Food Pilgrim's Field Guide to George Town & Beyond
siblings.summary: Penang's hawker legends, Michelin Bib stalls, kopitiams and one-star Nyonya, mapped by neighbourhood with EUR prices and closing days.

siblings.title: Sleep — Penang: Heritage Shophouses, Colonial Grandes Dames & Hill Retreats
siblings.summary: Where a couple should sleep in George Town and beyond — restored shophouses, the Blue Mansion, the E&O, design conversions, beach character and a hill retreat, with EUR price bands.

siblings.title: Do — Penang: semi-adventurous activities & day-trips from George Town
siblings.summary: What to actually do around Penang on a first visit: Penang Hill, national-park treks, Balik Pulau cycling, kayaking, snorkelling and the street-art trail.

siblings.title: See Penang: The Unmissable Icons of George Town & Beyond
siblings.summary: First-timer's guide to Penang's must-see icons: the UNESCO core, street art, clan houses, jetties, temples and Penang Hill, with 2026 hours and prices.

siblings.title: Offbeat Penang: Vipers, Ghost Tunnels, Pig-Blood Noodles and a Mosque on Stilts
siblings.summary: Twenty-odd weird, eerie and unexpected Penang finds a first-timer walks straight past.

siblings.title: Around & Day-Trips: Getting In, Out and About Penang
siblings.summary: How a couple based in George Town arrives, leaves and explores Penang — hops from the Cameron Highlands/KL, onward to Langkawi and the day-trip orbit.

sources.title: Malaysia public holidays 2026
sources.claim: Malaysia 2026 public-holiday dates: Thaipusam Feb 2, CNY Feb 17-18, Hari Raya Mar 21-22, Deepavali Nov 8.

sources.title: Hot air balloons set to soar in George Town in February
sources.claim: Penang Hot Air Balloon Fiesta runs Feb 13-15 2026 at the Polo Ground with ~15 balloons.

sources.title: Malaysia Chap Goh Meh complete guide
sources.claim: Chap Goh Meh 2026 falls on March 3, celebrated at The Esplanade in George Town.

sources.title: George Town Festival 2026 to feature over 40 events
sources.claim: GTF 2026 (17th edition) runs Aug 1-9 with 40+ events, seven ticketed shows, 80% free; tickets on sale June 10.

sources.title: Pinang Peranakan Mansion
sources.claim: Pinang Peranakan Mansion charges about RM25, opens daily 9:30-17:00 on Church Street, guided tour included.

sources.title: Thousands throng George Town streets for Thaipusam chariots
sources.claim: Thousands line George Town streets for the Thaipusam silver and gold chariot procession.

sources.title: Hin Bus Depot
sources.claim: Hin Bus Depot is a free-admission art and events space with a weekend market (Fri 12-19, Sat-Sun 10-17).

sources.title: Thaipusam Festival
sources.claim: Thaipusam 2026 falls Feb 2; Penang's Waterfall Temple hosts the grandest celebrations with kavadi-bearers.

sources.title: AI tracking added to 132-year-old silver chariot procession
sources.claim: Penang's Thaipusam silver chariot, shipped 1894 (132nd year), is 23.9m tall and 5 tonnes, now AI-tracked.

sources.title: Tradition meets technology with Penang's silver chariot
sources.claim: Penang's Chettiar community holds Chetti Pusam a day earlier with ~90 peacock kavadi.

sources.title: Penang Hot Air Balloon Fiesta 2026
sources.claim: The Penang Hot Air Balloon Fiesta 2026 is listed for Feb 13-15 in George Town.

sources.title: Penang Hot Air Balloon Fiesta (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: The Penang Hot Air Balloon Fiesta is an annual ballooning event held in George Town.

sources.title: Penang festivals calendar
sources.claim: Wesak Day 2026 May 31 with a Burmah Road float procession; World Heritage City Day July 7.

sources.title: Hungry Ghost Festival 2026
sources.claim: The Hungry Ghost Festival peak in 2026 falls around late August.

sources.title: Hungry Ghost Festival in Penang
sources.claim: Month-long 7th-lunar-month rituals and getai stage shows.

sources.title: St Anne's Festival in Bukit Mertajam
sources.claim: The Feast of St Anne runs ~10 days around the July 26 feast day.

sources.title: St Anne's Feast (mypenang)
sources.claim: St Anne's Feast includes a candlelight procession and a nine-day novena.

sources.title: Over 100,000 pilgrims to throng St Anne Feast
sources.claim: The St Anne Feast draws over 100,000 pilgrims.

sources.title: Deepavali in Penang
sources.claim: Deepavali 2026 is Nov 8; George Town's Little India is the focal point.

sources.title: The wonder of Deepavali in Penang Little India
sources.claim: Penang's Little India peaks at Deepavali with hanging lights and festive shopping.

sources.title: Little India of George Town
sources.claim: Little India offers sarees, brassware, spices and a row of jasmine/garland florists on Pitt Street.

sources.title: George Town Literary Festival
sources.claim: The George Town Literary Festival 2026 returns Nov 27-29.

sources.title: George Town Literary Festival (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: The George Town Literary Festival is Malaysia's leading international literary festival.

sources.title: Pinang Peranakan Mansion (travel-penang)
sources.claim: A restored Straits-Chinese tycoon's house holding over 1,000 antiques.

sources.title: Sun Yat-Sen Museum
sources.claim: Sun Yat-Sen Museum at 120 Armenian Street charges RM10 and opens daily 9-5, in an 1880s shophouse.

sources.title: Sun Yat Sen Museum Penang (mypenang directory)
sources.claim: Sun Yat-Sen Museum Penang official directory listing on Armenian Street.

sources.title: Batik Painting Museum Penang tickets
sources.claim: Batik Painting Museum Penang ticketing and visitor info for 2026.

sources.title: Batik Painting Museum Penang
sources.claim: Charges RM10, opens Tue-Sat 10:00-18:00, closed Sun/Mon, cash only.

sources.title: Batik Painting Museum (Penang Heritage Trust)
sources.claim: At 19 Armenian Street, ~70 batik paintings from the 1950s on, including pioneer Chuah Thean Teng.

sources.title: Penang Camera Museum
sources.claim: The Camera Museum is at 49 Lebuh Muntri, hours ~9:30-18:30.

sources.title: The Camera Museum
sources.claim: The Camera Museum's entrance fee is around RM25.

sources.title: Asia Camera Museum
sources.claim: The Asia Camera Museum (a separate venue on Lebuh Muntri) charges RM20.

sources.title: Made In Penang Interactive Museum
sources.claim: A 3D/trick-art and diorama museum of Penang trades.

sources.title: Made In Penang Interactive Museum (info)
sources.claim: Opening hours and entrance fee, at Pengkalan Weld.

sources.title: P. Ramlee's House
sources.claim: P. Ramlee's birth house is free and opens ~9:00-17:00, closed Mondays.

sources.title: P. Ramlee's Birth House
sources.claim: Birthplace of Malaysia's beloved film and music icon.

sources.title: P. Ramlee Birth House & Gallery (mypenang)
sources.claim: Official directory listing.

sources.title: Penang State Museum and Art Gallery (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: The state's official history museum on Farquhar Street.

sources.title: Penang State Museum set to reopen by year-end
sources.claim: In a RM20m restoration slated to reopen by end-2025, artefacts moved to a Macalister Road branch.

sources.title: Hin Market
sources.claim: Hin Market at Hin Bus Depot runs on weekends with local makers, food vendors and artists.

sources.title: Hin Bus Depot (reviews)
sources.claim: Established 2014, curates exhibitions, street art, gigs and events.

sources.title: Chowrasta Market
sources.claim: George Town's oldest market, known for preserved nutmeg and second-hand books.

sources.title: A guide to Chowrasta Market
sources.claim: Fresh produce downstairs; preserved fruits, belacan, pickles and spices upstairs.

sources.title: Chowrasta Market (mypenang)
sources.claim: Official tourism listing.

sources.title: Traditional craftsmanships in Penang
sources.claim: George Town retains traditional craftsmen including signboard carvers and other heritage trades.

sources.title: 10 Traditional Artisans in Penang
sources.claim: Songkok maker Haja Mohideen (King St), signboard carvers, and nyonya beaded-shoe maker Tan Kok Oo on Armenian St.

sources.title: 15 honourable craftsmen in George Town
sources.claim: George Town's honoured craftsmen keep heritage trades alive, including signboard carving.

sources.title: Penang Heritage Joss Stick Maker
sources.claim: At 1 Lorong Muda, founded ~1948 by Lee Beng Chuan, runs half-day joss-stick-making workshops.

sources.title: Traditional Joss Stick Making Workshop
sources.claim: A bookable workshop lets visitors mix paste and roll their own sticks.

sources.title: Penang's last traditional joss stick maker
sources.claim: Penang's last traditional joss-stick maker keeps the handmade craft alive.

sources.title: Flavours of Penang incl. batik workshop
sources.claim: A George Town tour pairs a batik workshop with a wet-market visit and home-cooked lunch.

sources.title: Rozana's Batik
sources.claim: Beginner workshops where you choose a waxed pattern and mix/blend colours.

sources.title: Penang Batik Factory
sources.claim: Teluk Bahang factory offers free guided tours of artisans plus hands-on sessions, Mon-Sat 9-17:30.

sources.title: Durian trees bloom early in Penang
sources.claim: Penang's 2026 durian season started early, promising a longer, cheaper, creamier crop.

sources.title: Durian Season Calendar
sources.claim: Penang's durian season calendar centres on a main mid-year season.

sources.title: Durians arrive earlier and tastier
sources.claim: In 2026 Penang durians arrived earlier and tastier than usual.
